Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
7.3.3.5.5.1 Operations – Query for operations from an Entity
[SWS_DM_01404] Support of
SOVD
method
Query for operations from an
Entity
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
For each
DiagnosticSovdOperation
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall provide the SOVD method
Query for operations from an Entity
ac-
cording to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02167] Retrieval of
SOVD
entity
operations
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
If the SOVD method
Query for operations from an Entity
is received, the
DM shall send a response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and add for each
available
DiagnosticSovdOperation
a SOVD
OperationDescription item
with the attributes:
id
set to the shortName of the
DiagnosticSovdOperation
[SWS_DM_01402],
name
set to the longName of the
DiagnosticSovdOperation
[SWS_DM_01401],
proximity_proof_required
set to
DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximi-
tyProofRequired
[SWS_DM_01400],
asynchronous_execution
set to
FALSE
, if
DiagnosticSovdOperationPrim-
itive
only aggregates a
DiagnosticSovdOperationStart
(DiagnosticSov-
dOperation.start), otherwise it is set to
TRUE
[SWS_DM_01399].
⌋

SOVD
operation attribute
id

⌈
The SOVD attribute
id
of a SOVD operation shall be derived from the

of
the corresponding

longName
of the corresponding
DiagnosticSovdOperation
.
⌋

SOVD
operation attribute
proximity_proof_required
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
The SOVD attribute
proximity_proof_required
of a SOVD operation shall de-
rived from the
proximityProofRequired
of the corresponding
DiagnosticSov-
dOperation
.
⌋
